name: Spring River — Cold Springs Boat Ramp to Imboden Boat Ramp
gaugeName: Spring River at Spring Street Bridge at Hardy, AR (USGS 07069305)
blurb: Spring River in Arkansas: sections between public Arkansas Game and Fish Commission accesses.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

sections.notes: Put-in Cold Springs Boat Ramp: exact agency access pin. Take-out Dam 3 Boat Ramp: exact agency access pin. Arkansas law: no glass containers in canoes, kayaks or tubes; keep food and drink in sealed containers, carry a closable trash bag affixed to the boat and use floating drink holders; children 12 and under wear life jackets. Banks and gravel bars beside private land may be private — use public accesses. Mileage: preliminary, measured along USGS river geometry (no agency mileage found).
